Where the money goes

Reserving takes a click. The part worth reading is what happens to the money between that click and the tag in your hand: it leaves your account once, sits with LandownerTags, and moves to the rancher only after the tag clears the check named on the row you picked.

  1. Reserve. The listing comes off the market and the price is locked. Nothing is charged on this domain.
  2. Pay into escrow. LandownerTags holds the funds. You can see them sitting there; the rancher can see the reservation.
  3. Verify. The tag is checked the way the listing says — staff or register. If it fails that check, the funds go back and the listing comes down.
  4. Release. The tag transfers, the funds release to the rancher, and the row disappears from this ledger the same day.
